newsitem.title: ITALY: Merrill ups Fiat to accumulate from neutral.
newsitem.headline: Merrill ups Fiat to accumulate from neutral.

text.p: Merrill Lynch said it had upgraded Fiat to near-term (up to 12 months) accumulate from neutral and confirmed its long-term neutral rating (over 12 months).

The upgrade, by Stephen Reitman and Maurizio Carulli, was made after Fiat chairman Cesare Romiti said in an Italian newspaper interview on Monday that group 1997 sales would be around 90 trillion lire, against 78 trillion in 1996, with profits forecast not below last year's 2.37 trillion lire.
Fiat shares posted an early 0.61 percent gain to 5,635 lire on Thursday on a slightly firmer Milan bourse.
